# Matt Waldman's RSP Cast — 2024-01-22

**Raw transcript:** `raw/ingested/rsp-cast/2024-01-22-rsp-feel-it-or-fk-it-12224-an-rsp-cast-with-bob-harris-and-matt-waldman.md` (immutable — do not edit)

## Summary

*Feel It or F**k It* with co-host **Bob Harris** (not tracked, and not
[[Chris Harris]]). A Divisional Round wrap-up and Conference Championship
preview, followed by a distinct second half where Waldman gives his own
first detailed 2024 QB prospect reads — notable because several disagree
with guest Daniel Harms's reads on the same players from
[[Matt Waldman's RSP Cast - 2024-01-15]] one week earlier, a real
expert-vs-guest split rather than corroboration.

**Divisional Round wrap:** [[Jordan Love]] defended against a costly closing
interception as first-year-starter growing pains, with a strong redraft
value case; [[Brock Purdy]] defended against "exposed as a game manager"
framing, with a specific ECR pushback; continued bullish reads on
[[Baker Mayfield]], [[Aaron Jones]] and [[Derrick Henry]]/[[Josh Jacobs]]
(both floated for Baltimore); a real reversal on [[Devin Singletary]]
(no longer Houston's presumptive 2024 starter); new pages for
[[Rashad Bateman]] and [[Chris Godwin]]; continued Green Bay receiver-room
tracking ([[Christian Watson]], [[Jayden Reed]], [[Romeo Doubs]],
[[Dontayvion Wicks]]) with an explicit "draft the cheapest piece" redraft
strategy given how the room may cannibalize itself; [[Khalil Shakir]] now
rated above both [[Gabe Davis]] and [[Stefon Diggs]], with real (unspecified)
smoke around a Diggs situation in Buffalo.

**Conference Championship preview:** Lions-49ers and Ravens-Chiefs picks,
with brief context added to [[Jared Goff]] and [[Lamar Jackson]].

**2024 QB prospect reads (Waldman's own, first pass):** new pages for
[[Jayden Daniels]] and [[J.J. McCarthy]]; updates to [[Bo Nix]] (a reversal
of Harms's skepticism), [[Drake Maye]] (more skeptical than Harms), and
[[Caleb Williams]] (broadly corroborates Harms), plus a downgrade on
[[Michael Penix Jr.]] from the 2024-01-11 framing. Closes with background on
the Rookie Scouting Portfolio product itself, captured on
[[Matt Waldman]]'s own expert page.

**Not given pages** (mentioned, no substantive standalone evaluative take):
Jawan Jennings and Bo Melton (SF/GB depth WRs — Waldman explicitly says he
hasn't seen enough to judge either), Trey Palmer and David Moore (Tampa Bay
depth WRs, thin mentions only), Isaiah Likely (mentioned only as a blocking
constraint on Rashad Bateman's role, not evaluated himself), a "Christian
Watson" reference in the Chiefs-receivers discussion that does not match any
tracked player context (likely a co-host misspeak conflating names — not
ingested as a claim about the actual [[Christian Watson]], who plays for
Green Bay, not Kansas City).
